function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate entries, meaning 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset. According to the data dictionary, `sample_seq` indicates the assay run number, and the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for the same patient.", "implication": "The analysis must deduplicate by `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, re-tested patients would be double-counted, and their measurements would be over-weighted in any average.
